reason: The README presents a code-first generative UI plugin that lets an Agent create, validate, and serve task-specific React interfaces while carrying saved interaction state into later Agent turns; connected tools are declared and permission-gated.

summaries.zh: 一个让智能体生成并运行面向具体任务的 React 交互界面、保存用户操作状态并供后续对话继续使用的插件。
summaries.en: A plugin that lets an Agent generate and run task-specific React interfaces, save user interaction state, and continue the task in later turns.

capabilities: Generates task-specific React and TypeScript interfaces
Builds and checks generated application code
Persists user selections and form state for later Agent turns
Serves generated applications inline, in Canvas, fullscreen, or through localhost links
Supports declared MCP tools and credential-free public HTTPS routes subject to permission review
